description: Add a history of a ball value. A history is a table of floating point values assigned by sampling a model attribute periodically during a simulation. The ball must be specified by either 'id' or 'position' keyword. Quantities that can be recorded include position, velocity, displacement, spin, euler, force-contact, force-unbalanced, moment-contact, moment-unbalanced, stress, ratio-local, and convergence. Live 9.7: the quantity slot was fully enumerated (Batch P1); an object selector (id <i> or position <v>) is REQUIRED after the quantity - omitting it fails with 'No object for history specified'.

python_sdk_alternative.workaround: itasca.command('ball history ...') or manually record values using itasca.set_callback() with Ball getter methods

6.0: Live 6.00 first-slot enumeration; an object selector is required after the quantity.
7.0: Live 7.0 first-slot enumeration; an object selector is required after the quantity (same grammar as 9.x).
9.0: Live 9.7 first-slot enumeration; an object selector is required after the quantity. The former official-page spellings (magnitude/index/log/position/vector/zz) are rejected per-keyword on live 9.7.

syntax.6.0: ball history [name <sid>] keyword id <id> or position <v>
